blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `deleteOrderChangeWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow deletes one or more order changes.

You can use this workflow within your customizations or your own custom workflows, allowing you to wrap custom logic around
deleting an order change.
